justification: The claim of operational robustness is not supported because the validation documentation explicitly lacks evaluation results for stressful conditions such as altered document formats, OCR degradation, out-of-distribution samples, or perturbation testing. Furthermore, standard validation was conducted on samples drawn from the same sources as the training corpus, which does not test for robustness.
evidence_used: The available validation documentation contains no results for altered document formats.
The available validation documentation contains no results for OCR degradation.
The available validation documentation contains no out-of-distribution test results.
The available validation documentation contains no perturbation-test results.
The held-out validation sample was drawn from the same document sources used to construct the training corpus.
